statuses.implemented: Code exists; its own tests pass
statuses.locally_verified: Implemented and checked end to end on this PC (tests, build, and the real surface where one exists)
statuses.blocked_owner: Needs an owner decision or material
statuses.blocked_provider: Needs a key, budget or provider account
statuses.blocked_hardware: Needs the second desktop or other hardware
statuses.blocked_external_qa: Needs native-speaker, expert or rights review
statuses.outcome_unvalidated: Works as software; no evidence yet that it improves learning
